title: get_health reply payload (xi.health/1)
description: The canonical health snapshot returned by `get_health`: the top-level state machine value plus one entry per component, with per-kind extra fields (crash_count on instances, queue stats on groups, last_emit_age_ms on sources). Consumers must tolerate unknown states/health literals (forward-open enums) and unknown fields. Exercised by protocol/fixtures/get_health.json.

state.description: Top-level state machine value. Open set: consumers treat unknown values as a neutral/unknown state (forward compatibility), so no closed enum here.

health.description: Open set (ok / degraded / failed today); unknown values tolerated.
